# statement about

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:statementAbout`](gmeow-statementAbout.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/statementAbout>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
